summary: Iteration 87 - Large Feature Batch Testing Complete. All 33 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all 5 new feature pages: Workflow Automation Builder, Device Terminal, Stripe Billing Portal, Scheduled Reports, and Login Page with interactive particle animation. All features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 87 tested 5 major new features. All backend APIs and frontend UIs working correctly. Key endpoints tested: Workflow Automation (CRUD, toggle, test execution, 12 triggers, 14 actions), Device Terminal (sessions, command execution with simulated output), Stripe Billing Portal (client billing, portal links, reminders, stats), Scheduled Reports (CRUD, toggle, send-now, logs), AI Ticket Triage (GPT-powered analysis via emergentintegrations). Login page has interactive particle animation with mouse magnetic attraction effect. Navigation paths: Workflow Builder at /workflow-automation (Infrastructure > Security Tools > Workflow Builder), Terminal at /device-terminal (Infrastructure > Security Tools > Live Terminal), Billing Portal at /billing-portal (Business > Finance Center > Billing Portal), Scheduled Reports at /scheduled-reports (Reports & Comms > Reports > Scheduled Emails).
